comment: Chunk-integrity probe target list. Runs from James .27 every 60s. Detects Next.js manifest/disk drift BEFORE users hit a 404-littered page. Non-Next.js services (racecontrol :8080, comms-link :8766, go2rtc, ollama) are NOT in this file — they need a different probe class (build_id drift / service health).

targets.name: venue-web
targets.restart_action: verify schtask name then schtasks /Run /TN StartWeb (on .23)

targets.name: venue-kiosk
targets.restart_action: verify schtask name then schtasks /Run /TN StartKiosk (on .23)

targets.name: cloud-admin
targets.restart_action: pm2 restart racingpoint-admin via Bono relay

targets.name: cloud-web
targets.restart_action: pm2 restart racingpoint-web via Bono relay

targets.name: cloud-kiosk
targets.restart_action: pm2 restart racingpoint-kiosk via Bono relay
